title: Malicious code in dowload_ebok_1_and_2_thessalonians_by_andy_johnson_7yj6d (npm)
description: The npm package 'dowload_ebok_1_and_2_thessalonians_by_andy_johnson_7yj6d' contains malicious code that can fully compromise any computer on which it is installed or run. The compromise may allow an attacker to gain full control over the system, potentially exposing all stored secrets and keys. Immediate removal of the package is advised, but full remediation may require rotating all secrets from a different, uncompromised machine due to the risk of persistent malicious software.
